item.title: United States, Israel Launch Strikes On Iran As Tehran Reports Explosions Nationwide
item.description: US and Israel strike Iran in a coordinated attack, Tehran reports explosions, smoke rises, and military tensions escalate rapidly.

item.title: Missile Strikes Hit US Bases Across Gulf Amid Rising Middle-East Tensions
item.description: Iran launches missile strikes across Gulf, hitting US, Israel, UAE, Kuwait bases, escalating tensions with Trump administration rapidly.

item.title: Ayo Arise Backs State Police, Says Constitutional Amendment Is Urgent
item.description: Former senator Ayo Arise urges swift amendment of Section 214, says decentralised policing is key to tackling Nigeria’s worsening insecurity.

item.title: OpenAI Secures Pentagon AI Deal Hours After Trump Administration Blocks Rival Anthropic
item.description: OpenAI signs Pentagon agreement for AI in classified military systems, while Trump bans Anthropic over supply chain concerns.

item.title: Clinton Denies Knowledge Of Epstein Crimes, Defends Hillary In House Oversight Testimony
item.description: Bill Clinton tells House panel he saw nothing, did nothing wrong, and cut ties with Epstein after 2008 plea.

item.title: Iran Revolutionary Guards Warn Ships Against Transit Across Strait Of Hormuz, EU Naval Official Says
item.description: EU naval mission reports ships have received Iranian warnings blocking Strait of Hormuz, a vital global oil chokepoint.

item.title: Yemeni Houthis Announce Resumption Of Red Sea Ship Attacks
item.description: Yemeni Houthis say they will resume targeting ships in Red Sea, escalating regional maritime security tensions.

item.title: SunTrust Bank Surpasses ₦50bn Recapitalisation Target After Successful Private Placement
item.description: SunTrust Bank’s paid-up capital climbed to about ₦51.1bn after private placement, beating the recapitalisation deadline.

item.title: Trump Says Iran’s Ayatollah Khamenei Is Dead
item.description: Trump says Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Khamenei killed in joint strikes as Tehran has yet to confirm the claim.

item.title: Trump Confirms Iran Supreme Leader Khamenei and 40 Iranian Leaders Killed In US-Israel Airstrikes
item.description: Trump confirms the death of Iranian Supreme Leader Khamenei and 40 Iranian leaders killed in US-Israel strikes.
